name: localai
label: LocalAI
description: The free, Self-hosted, community-driven and local-first. Drop-in replacement for OpenAI running on consumer-grade hardware. No GPU required.

base_url.label: Server URL
base_url.description: The address of your LocalAI server, for example http://localhost:8080/v1. It must be reachable from Activepieces. The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

access_token.label: Access Token
access_token.description: One of the API keys your server was started with (--api-keys or API_KEY). Leave empty if the server has no keys.

model.label: Model
model.description: The chat model on your LocalAI server that will write the answer.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: Higher is more random, lower is more focused. Defaults to 0.9.

maxTokens.label: Maximum Tokens
maxTokens.description: Longest answer to generate, in tokens. Defaults to 2048.

topP.label: Top P
topP.description: Nucleus sampling, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 1.

frequencyPenalty.label: Frequency penalty
frequencyPenalty.description: From -2 to 2. Higher repeats lines less. Defaults to 0.

presencePenalty.label: Presence penalty
presencePenalty.description: From -2 to 2. Higher moves to new topics. Defaults to 0.6.

roles.label: Roles
roles.description: Messages sent before the question, each with a role and content.

create_embedding.label: Create Embedding
create_embedding.description: Turn text into a vector for semantic search or clustering.

model.label: Model
model.description: An embedding model installed on your LocalAI server.

input.label: Text
input.description: The text to turn into a vector.
